real_s2.explanation: The unit prefers photos with a single, clear, well-defined main subject: one that is sharp, brightly lit, fills a large part of the frame and sits centrally. It responds weakly to cluttered scenes with no single main subject, dark scenes, and blurry ones. It also prefers natural, untinted color over warm-tinted photos. Facing direction, tilt and cropping matter little.

real_s3.explanation: The unit is most active on photos with one clear, well-lit, sharp main subject that fills much of the frame, such as cameras, dogs, gadgets and spiders, and usually sits near the center. It is least active on cluttered scenes with no single subject, on dark or blurry photos, and on photos with a warm color cast. Its preference for untinted, neutral-color photos over warm-tinted ones rests on large photo groups, and the similar units do not share it.
